caption: A dense, fog-overcast sky fills the frame, with a faint pale circular halo resting at the left mid-height. A darker cloud bank stretches across the top edge, leaving a small gap of blue sky near the upper center, while a brownish-gray layer of mist occupies the lower half. The halo holds its position throughout, its visibility waxing and waning gently. Above, the cloud band reshapes slowly, and the patch of blue sky at the upper right opens up progressively. The lower fog masses morph and shift in subtle, continuous motion, their edges softening and reforming. Gentle fluctuations in brightness and contrast ripple through the hazy layer, keeping the whole scene in quiet, ongoing drift.
relations: The pale circular halo remains fixed at left mid-height while its brightness gently fluctuates.
The dark upper cloud band reshapes slowly, causing the small gap of blue sky to expand progressively.
The brownish-gray mist in the lower half morphs and shifts continuously, with edges softening and reforming.
Gentle fluctuations in brightness ripple through the hazy layer, maintaining a quiet, ongoing drift.
